headline: French Consumer Sentiment Hits Decade Low Amid Protests
summary: French consumer sentiment declined by 5 points to 80 in October, marking its lowest level since June 2013 amid nationwide protests, according to INSEE.
why: Consumer confidence is a leading indicator for household consumption and retail sales, which drive a significant portion of the eurozone's economic growth.

impacts.name: Retail & Consumer
impacts.why: Lower consumer confidence typically correlates with reduced discretionary spending and weaker retail sector performance.
